_meta.description: Every distinct inline SVG icon used by the unified cabinet (proto.html) and the shapers module (shapers.html). Format: {name: {viewBox, attrs, inner, source, note?, module}}. Render as <svg viewBox=… {attrs}>{inner}</svg>. Sprite icons i-* get their stroke styling from CSS .ic (see note on each).

modules.cabinet: proto.html — header account entry, select chevrons, shared small icons, rental art
modules.shapers: shapers.html — <symbol> sprite (i-*), generated board silhouettes (board-*, also exported as frontend-port/assets/shaper-board-*.svg), select chevron

_meta.glyphs: Many cabinet/shaper icons are Unicode glyphs, not SVG — see _glyphs. TZ UX-04: replace them by one SVG set with equal stroke width.
_meta.notIncluded: Public-only SVGs (loader-art, empty-surfers, gg-schematic-land, wind-rose, welcome sticker…) live in frontend-port/icons.json.

cabinet._comment: The unified cabinet uses Unicode glyphs (not SVG) as icons. Keep the same semantics; TZ UX-04 asks to replace them by a consistent SVG set of equal stroke width.

shapers.note: Non-SVG glyphs used as icons (replace with SVG in production): «★» rating star (.star, colour #ffae00; reviews «★★★★★» 27px); «×» order-modal close, thumbnail/video/promo/works delete crosses (.gv-thumb-remove/.gv-media-cross), custom-type & custom-material remove, chat attachment remove; «▶» «▶ Промо», «▶ Промо-видео», «▶ Видео доски»; «‹ ›» maker carousel arrows (.gv-carousel-nav, 23px); «→» in link buttons; «✓» «✓ Ремонт досок» (legacy maker heading); «📷» chat thread preview for photo-only message («📷 Фото» / «📷 Фотография»); «♧» legacy model-param bullets (replaced by ruler/droplets SVG).
